text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ha! Is that sound... a conch horn?! That 
means—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Have you only now realized, 
unprovoked Valkyrie? This place is 
already—a battlefield!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
What! An ambush... No, look at those 
faces! Could this be... treason!?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! Rejoice and make merry! For I 
shall dedicate a dance truly befitting a 
devotee of the classics such as 
yourself...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
A traditional dance from this land. Let us 
dance it... with Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho! Nya-ha-ha~ You folks truly are 
delightful. I shall dance too♪ Yo-i, yo-i♪ 
Yo-i, yo-i♪

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Still, how should I thank you for this... 
Well, there's always that one way!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
—On the true battlefield, I shall return 
the surprise unto you all! Wahaha!♪
